title: Legacy Console Tooltip
description: Turns The Current Console Tooltips into the Legacy Version of The Console Tooltips
body:
This is a Texture Pack specifically meant to replace some of the tooltips to Legacy Console ones like the good 'ol days. (Only for [Controllable](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/controllable) by MrCrayfish)

### The Texture Pack replaces
- Xbox 360 Tooltips
- Xbox One Tooltips
- PS3 Tooltips
- PS4 Tooltips
